correctness.rationale: The global event is localized to one normal chart. The squared-distance, area density and radial boundary displacement are all expanded to the required order, with uniformly controlled remainders. Exact Dirichlet half-moment and beta computations give I0=pi^2/42, I1=2pi^2/495, I2=pi^2/990. Gauss--Bonnet then gives the stated chi coefficient. A separately derived spherical side-density series reproduces epsilon^4/672-epsilon^6/31680. The standalone exact checker passed.
